name: seleziomar-skills
description: Open-source skills for AI coding agents. Ships trial-by-fire (test your own delivery the way QA or the client would, before handing it over) and by-the-book (review a change against the repository's own written rules, plus bugs, security and missing tests).

plugins.name: trial-by-fire
plugins.description: Adversarial pre-delivery testing: prove a change works, and keeps working, before it reaches the client.

plugins.name: by-the-book
plugins.description: Code review against the repository's written rules (CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules), with correctness bugs, security and missing tests, by three read-only agents.
